title: Notch export bug 2
content:
Hello.

I am writing to inquire about an issue where notches are not displayed when extracting patterns to PDF.

From what I understand, this bug was fixed in version 26.0, but I am currently using version 26.0.356.

Is there a solution?

ps. I tried downgrading to version 2025.2.330, but the result is the same. I made sure to check Baseline/Notch Extraction during the extraction.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi Kaaette. Just a heads up that the same team answers both here and on Discord. So no need to post to both places :)

title: "Custom measurement" is a useless feature
content:
The whole point of custom measurements for graphics is to create a point of reference so the graphic can be placed accurately in a real life application, but there's NO WAY to translate this information to any exportable data. It isnt in POMS it isnt in anything outside of the file so the only thing you can do is take a screenshot and give it to the print house.  
  
What. This seems like an incredibly important part of the production process that is completely missing from clo. Simple features like this and not able to export shrinkage data to DXF printing make clo completely unusable for production.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi there, you can place an additional POM for the graphic placement with a few clicks, which would be less of a hassle than taking and sharing a screenshot. You can also shrink pattern pieces by editing them by percentage and export that as a DXF.
content_description: Highlighting the critical limitations of CLO software in exporting custom measurement data and shrinkage information essential for accurate graphic placement and production.

title: How To Move Two Nodes To The Opposite Direction At Once?
content:
![9307badac38d460f9ea052635195fd2e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/7f7e053c20334e9e93ecf32a3ee7c5d5/images/9307badac38d460f9ea052635195fd2eScreenshot%202026-07-08%20at%2018.05.06.png)

How To Move Two Nodes To The Opposite Direction At Once?

I want to move the nodes C and D to the opposite direction 2 cm.

How can I do this?

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Ok. Thank you very much.

Comment 2: The triangle is not half symmetrical. But now I draw the triangle outside the rectangle. And apply Change Length to the base and choose "Both Sides".Thanks for the answer.
Reply 1: Click on each point in question and hold down the left mouse button, then move your mouse. As you are dragging the point's position, without releasing the left mouse button, right-click at the same time. A precision window appears and you can input the 2cm.
Reply 2: Both nodes goes into the same direction with your method?
Reply 3: Melodys method is correct is you do not want to use Symmetry. You move one side first with precision in one direction and then move the other side in the opposite direction with precision
Reply 4: Yeah. But what I asked is doing this "at once".??
Reply 5: It's not possible to move them at once in different directions without using symmetry.

Comment 3: A half symmetric pattern.........
content_description: This web page provides guidance on how to simultaneously move two nodes (C and D) 2 cm in opposite directions.

title: How To Do Dynamic Editing
content:
I’m trying to draft sleeve pattern.

![0ac2b27ec8c246a1a2ac5c6488c45486](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/bf885f05d46443759b7115b4b3764952/images/0ac2b27ec8c246a1a2ac5c6488c45486Screenshot%202026-07-08%20at%2017.34.28.png)

I’m trying to move the segment including A and B lines higher. (A + B is the triangle base)

A = B

But while doing this I want both sides of the triangle (C and D) adapt themselves to the movement of the triangle base dynamically.

So the A + B measurement increases. (I want to set It to the specific bicep line measurement.)

Also C + D measurements increases.

It will be still A = B.

Is there a fetaure for It?

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Actually I noticed It edits dynamically in this way. I draw the triangle outside the rectangle and move the base in the y axis direction. And the triangle sides are editing accordingly.Thank for the answer.

Comment 2: No. This is really not how CLO works at all....If you want to set a exact length just R-click on the line and do change lengthBut before you do that you should be shaping the cap with curves, otherwise setting the length is pointless. since curving everything will obviously change the overall length.You may want to buy an actual pattern making book to really understand sleeve drafting. The patterning book Mad about Sleeves would be good
Reply 1: Ok then. I assume Dynamic Editing is not possible on CLO currently.Thank you very much for the answer.
content_description: This web page helps users dynamically adjust sleeve pattern segments so that the triangle base (A + B) and its sides (C and D) scale proportionally while maintaining A = B.

title: Feature Request - Topstitches Disappear While Switching Into Simulation Mode
content:
When I switch into the Simulation Mode the Topstitches disappear.

I use colorful Topstitches as guides of the seemliness and I can not see them in Simulation Mode.

Could you fix It please?

Thanks.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: When you select the pattern in Simulation It still gets lost. Because the pattern and its borders looks "yellow".
Reply 1: Yellow means selected. Maybe change the color of the stitch or deselect the pattern.And as we have asked you many times always add a reference image. Ad my reply above is just a guess.But also this is mentioned in the CLO quick start which you have been recommended and said you have watched watched. Maybe watching this and repeating the exercise will help you start to remember these CLO foundational basic skills.CLO take the Intro to CLO on CLO Academy. You have many questions, but most can usually be answered by just pausing to think through the processCLO is not magic and will not just work how you want it to. You need to learn to work with CLO.

Comment 2: Hi. This is commonly noted and mentioned in many tutorials. If you want to see topstitches while simulating you must change from OBJ to Texture type. Then you will see them.Keeping them as an OBJ is Not possible as it would be to heavy to simulate
content_description: This web page serves to report and request a fix for the issue where colorful topstitches used as seam guides disappear when switching to Simulation Mode.

title: Feature Request - Some Updates For 3D State
content:
Request 1 - I do not know which 3D State I am in.

Clo does not show It to you.

I want It to be fixed.

Request 2 - When you switch to other 3D state you get this notification;

"Loading the 3D State will delete the current History. Would you like to proceed?"

And while doing quick changes and saves

This notification disrupt your workflow.

Request 3 - Multiple Selection Of 3D States.

Currently you cannot select more than single 3D State at once.

So you have to select and delete them one by one.

Request 4 - Saving 3D State as Separate Project File (Both Avatar and Pattern arranged, sewn etc.)

Request 5 - Normally when you add a 3D State It is not automatically added to the project.

You have to save It separately to the project by CMD + S.

I want It automatically saved. Or as an option It can be added. 

Edit : Request 3 & Request 4 & 5 is added.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Request 5 - Normally when you add a 3D State It is not automatically added to the project.You have to save It separately to the project by CMD + S.I want It automatically saved. Or as an option It can be added.

Comment 2: Request 4 - Saving 3D State as Separate Project File (Both Avatar and Pattern arranged, sewn etc.)

Comment 3: Request 3 - Multiple Selection Of 3D States.Currently you cannot select more than single 3D State at once.So you have to select and delete them one by one.

Comment 4: Request 1 - You previously asked for this and that was already put in by our teamRequest 2 - This is a safety feature to make sure users do not accidently remove or lose work. So this would Not be removed
Reply 1: "Request 2 - This is a safety feature to make sure users do not accidently remove or lose work. So this would Not be removed"Clo can present an option to disable this notification for people who wants.Because whilst back and forth among 3D States this notification slows the process.
content_description: This web page gathers user feedback and feature requests aimed at improving 3D state management, notifications, multi-selection, and saving workflows in the CLO software.
